source_quote: 1 Enrollment: fee paid by new students upon the decision to join RHU and credited to the statement
answer: New students pay a USD 150 enrollment fee (credited to the first semester's statement of fees) and a USD 150 deposit, which is refunded only upon graduation.

source_quote: 3 NSSF subscription: An annual fee payable by Lebanese students who are not registered with the
answer: The NSSF subscription is LBP 8,400,000, an annual fee payable by Lebanese students who are not registered with the NSSF.

source_quote: Per summer session 125
answer: Service fees are USD 250 per semester and USD 125 per summer session.

source_quote: CO-OP 220 Late Registration 20
answer: The Co-op fee is USD 220.

source_quote: Late Registration 20
answer: The late registration fee is USD 20.

source_quote: 5 Late Payment Fee: An additional charge for any installment not paid by the established deadline.
answer: A late payment fee of LBP 3,000,000 + USD 30 is charged on each installment not paid by the deadline.

source_quote: 4 Deferred Payment: Payments of tuition fees will be scheduled over four installments for the fall
answer: Tuition payments are scheduled over four installments in fall and spring and two installments in summer; the deferred payment fee is USD 20 per semester.

source_quote: Per semester (Deferred over two installments) 480
answer: The optional regular shuttle costs USD 480 per semester (deferred over two installments) and USD 240 per summer session. Routes: Beirut-RHU, Saida-RHU (Mokhtara-RHU and Iqlim-RHU when applicable). It is non-refundable from week two.

source_quote: Per semester Car/Motorbike 80/20
answer: Parking fees are USD 80 (car) / USD 20 (motorbike) per semester, and USD 40 / USD 10 per summer session.

source_quote: Single room -fall or spring semesters (Block A) 1100
answer: Dorm rates (USD): double room in shared apartment, Block A - 850 per fall/spring semester, 425 summer; single room Block A - 1100 per fall/spring, 550 summer; single room Block F - 1200 per fall/spring, 600 summer.

source_quote: 7 Dorm Deposit Fee: Refunded to the student upon the decision to leave the facility and only when
answer: The dorm deposit is USD 100. It is refunded when the student leaves the facility and only if the room furniture and assets are handed in free of damage.
review_note: p.38 footnote says refunded upon decision to leave the facility; p.39 says refundable upon graduation and leaving the dormitory. Wording differs.

source_quote: 8 Dorm Late Payment: An additional Charge that may reach $100 upon excessive delay in payment.
answer: The dorm late payment fee is a minimum of USD 25 and may reach USD 100 for excessive delay; if dues are not paid, residency is not renewed.

source_quote: Students with financial holds will not have access to their grades and cannot register
answer: Students with financial holds cannot access their grades, cannot register during the regular registration period, and cannot get any official university document until the holds are cleared.

source_quote: student registers for a course, he/she shall remain accountable for all applicable tuition
answer: Students must pay all balances by the announced deadlines to avoid late fees and the risk of courses being dropped. Once registered, a student remains accountable for the course tuition and fees unless the course is formally dropped by the drop/add deadline.

source_quote: Payments must be made in cash by the announced deadlines through one of the
answer: Payments must be made in cash by the deadlines at any BankMed branch or the RHU Finance Department. Students must download and print their statement of fees from the SIS and present it at the time of payment.

source_quote: All student payments will be automatically deferred over four payments for the fall and
answer: All student payments are automatically deferred over four payments in fall and spring and over two in summer.

source_quote: During the drop-and-add period, paid fees for the dropped course(s) will be credited
answer: Fees paid for a course dropped during the drop-and-add period are credited in full to the student's statement of fees. No refund applies after the drop-and-add period unless the student withdraws due to emergent circumstances.

source_quote: Before the official beginning of classes, 75% of the tuition and fees are refunded.
answer: For a student who paid all tuition and fees and officially withdraws from the university: 75% refund before classes begin; 50% on the first day of classes and during drop/add; no refund after drop/add. Students on the deferred payment program get no refund.

source_quote: Upon completion of the graduation requirements, the student must fill out a clearance
answer: After completing graduation requirements, the student fills out a clearance form from the Registrar's Office; the general deposit is refunded once the form is completed and signed. All deposits are refunded after deducting any outstanding balances.
